readme_notes.note: NB9 Feedback Loop Analysis: consolidate the user-described content of the 19 NIRA-related posts and five government/official response records as a working evidence register.
Summaries reflect details the user described in prior conversation. They are not independent verification of the original posts. Original links/screenshots should be checked where available.

Conflicting descriptions exist (workbook metadata says Telefishinka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, 2025-12-26; other notes mention an Eid greeting and an embassy-in-Uganda NIRA service). Resolve against original post before analysis.
Content was not recoverable from available notes. Use original metadata worksheet or post URL to fill it; do not infer the content.
Temporal proximity and topical similarity do not establish that public comments caused an official response. Code linkage as strong/possible/unsupported only based on direct documentary evidence.
This workbook is a new consolidated file and does not overwrite existing project files.

join_to_comment_corpus: Not possible from this workbook. The post register has no post_url, and the comment corpus has no POST_01-style identifier. No crosswalk was inferred.
authority: The workbook's own read-me states that summaries reflect details described by the user and are not independent verification of the original posts.
